reason: I check how long a seller has been around and read their reviews, and this one has none. I can get used sets on Marketplace or eBay for less, so I'd need a reason to pick a brand new seller at £280.
objection: New seller with no reviews and no track record, and £280 is more than the used sets I can find already. Checking in person and paying on collection helps, but I'd still be going out to Bexleyheath to look at a set that might not fit my car.
would_change_my_mind: A few real reviews or a seller profile with some history, or the price at about £220 with tyres included.
